steps.text: You now manage this community: its card shows your new role. Click "Open my community" — its dashboard is no longer a member's.
steps.title: You are a manager

steps.text: The dashboard now sums up the whole community. "Things to check" lists what is blocking, with a link to the screen where you fix it; then come the shared energy, the operations and the recent activity.
steps.title: The manager dashboard

steps.text: Your role added the "Management" section to the sidebar: the allocation keys, the members, meters and sharing operations, the community's users and the audit log. Hover the bar to read its labels.
Tap the menu icon to open the navigation.
Your role added the "Management" section to the menu: the allocation keys, the members, meters and sharing operations, the community's users and the audit log.
steps.title: The "Management" section

steps.text: "Member manager" groups the community's day-to-day work: "Manage members", "Manage meters" and "Sharing operations".
steps.title: Members, meters, operations

steps.text: Here you keep the list of members. "Add" fills in a record; "Invite a new member" sends an email so the person completes it themselves and gets access to their own space.
steps.title: Add and invite members

steps.text: Tap the menu icon to open the navigation.
In the menu's "Management" section, tap "Key manager".
steps.title: The allocation keys

steps.text: An allocation key sets how the shared energy is split between an operation's consumers. "Add" lets you choose between the full form and a step-by-step wizard. The "User guide" offers a detailed tour of each of these screens.
steps.title: Allocation keys
